title: Distributive Property Visualizer
creator: Claude Code with microsim-p5 skill
subject: Mathematics - Algebra
description: An interactive MicroSim that visualizes the distributive property using synchronized area models and step-by-step algebraic expansion. Students can explore how a(b + c) = ab + ac through color-coded visual representations and animated algebraic steps.
topic: Distributive Property, Algebraic Expressions, Area Models
learningObjectives: Understand the distributive property through visual area models
Apply the distributive property to numeric and algebraic expressions
Recognize that a(b + c) = ab + ac
Distribute positive and negative factors correctly

technicalMetadata.accessibility: Screen reader support via describe() function

controls.name: Show Next Step
controls.description: Advance one step through the solution

controls.name: Random Problem
controls.description: Generate a random problem of selected type

assumptions: Visual and algebraic representations are equivalent
limitations: Limited to two terms inside parentheses
Simplified product display for complex expressions

assessmentOpportunities: Can students explain why both terms must be multiplied?
Can students predict results before animating?
Do students understand the connection between area and algebra?
Can students work problems with negative factors?
Can students apply to variable expressions?
commonCoreStandards: 6.EE.A.3 - Apply properties of operations to generate equivalent expressions
7.EE.A.1 - Apply properties of operations to expand linear expressions
A-SSE.A.2 - Use structure of expressions to rewrite them
